feature: Jellyfin server-offset seeking, automatic resume and Continue Watching/Next Up folders

changes.connection: Native HTTP numeric IPv4/default8096; Xbox keyboard for server/user/password; private atomic bearer-token config; startup validation/retry and disconnect/remove; no password persistence or request/token logging.
changes.browser: Continue Watching and Next Up use account-specific Resume and Shows/NextUp endpoints before video libraries. Preserve server ordering and10-item pagination, virtual-root pagination and empty lists. Stop refreshes the current folder.
changes.playback: Authenticated PlaybackInfo and progressive MPEG-TS MPEG2/MP2, up to1280x720/30fps,8Mbps video, stereo48kHz/192kbps audio. Server transcoding required. Same Blades decoder/GPU path. Playback reporting/encoder cleanup.
changes.HTTP_AVIO: Bounded cancellable socket transport; remote32KiB AVIO buffer avoids old FFmpeg2.8 refill assertion on fragmented streams. Local64KiB and v0.43 decoder/GPU optimisations retained.
changes.seeking_resume: Left/Right10second server-offset seek via StartTimeTicks within the same session, authenticated active-encoder cleanup, cancellable/coalesced opens, paused-state retention and full-item timestamp mapping. Fresh user-item data supplies automatic resume from any folder; zero/missing/finished ticks start over, valid partial rewatch ticks resume. Start/progress/stop report absolute positions and CanSeek. Server resume thresholds still apply.
changes.limits: No DNS/HTTPS/base-path/redirect support, subtitles, Live TV or quality selector. Seeking restarts server transcoding and buffers briefly; no offline media download or external-player adapter.
changes.licence: GPLv3 combined binary, complete corresponding source/build scripts and pinned SDK; original MIT/GPL/FFmpeg/XenonFin/artwork notices preserved.
